Great game for anyone looking for a long game to play over a long long time.

I have been playing since launch, and the least I can say is this game is phenomenal. It may not be every person's cup of tea, but the developers work insanely hard EVERY day. Warframe has evolved so much since I first started playing it regularly baffles me. With every update they add so much content I honestly don't know how they do it. It is a bit of a grind at times, but I can't think of a game that isn't, especially a free to play one. That being said it is by far the most enjoyable grind of any game I have ever played, and I always end up coming back for more. I could go on for hours about how great this game is, but they best thing you can do for yourself is just try it. Seriously this game is a 10/10 for me. Happy hunting Tenno!
Good game. It is fun to play with friends and progresing through the game is enjoyable bla.

The amount of time I put into this game is definitely on the low end. I'd definitely still be considered a beginner. 

That being said, the reason I put it down is that is became clear the game is designed in such a way that you constantly encounter roadblocks that either require you grind/wait something out, or pay money. Example include having to keep your pet fed and happy to keep it fighting for you or having to wait literal days to craft many weapons and warframes. I bought the new player bundle for this game which definitely helped jumping in feel more like a paid game than a free to play grind. But there is just SO. MUCH. GRINDING. If that's what you enjoy, then you'll enjoy this game. But it just started getting boring quickly. Even the decent variety in enemies gets boring very quickly when that's all you'll be doing in the game. This game seems to play like what destiny should have been (though I have play comparatively even less of that game), but still feels like it really falls short of an enjoyable experience for the massive amount of time it expects you to invest into it
